_note: ALGO SAYS cards (no source labels on screen, D-121). A lesson fires the first time its conditions hold at the moment named by when (analysis = first results, done = the post ended, return = a return came in, update = after a platform update). if = all conditions [fact, op, value]. any = a list of condition lists, one must hold. Facts are built in js/sim/lessons.js.

lessons.title: Posting is not enough
lessons.text: Posting is not enough. Timing and fit decide reach.

lessons.title: Each site pays differently
lessons.text: Short videos pay fast and fade. Long videos pay slow and last.

lessons.title: Match the moment
lessons.text: Match the site to the moment.

lessons.title: Views are not sales
lessons.text: Views are attention. Sales need answers, trust, and stock.

lessons.title: Algorithms change
lessons.text: Algorithms change. Test, do not trust blindly.

lessons.title: The first seconds
lessons.text: The first seconds must say what this is.

lessons.title: Honesty
lessons.text: Misleading content wins clicks and loses buyers.

lessons.title: Nobody has the formula
lessons.text: No one outside a site knows its exact formula. Sites share their main signals. Test the rest yourself.

lessons.title: Viewers shape their feeds
lessons.text: Each viewer's feed follows what they watched, liked, and followed before. Make videos for buyers who already like this kind of product.

lessons.title: Followers are a head start
lessons.text: Followers see your post first. Strangers decide how far it goes. A small account can still reach many people.

lessons.title: Shares spread a post
lessons.text: When viewers share a video, it reaches more new people.

lessons.title: Two steps on YouView
lessons.text: YouView first picks a few hundred videos for each viewer, then ranks them. Your title and topic decide if you get picked.

lessons.title: Satisfied viewers count
lessons.text: A click starts a view. Viewers who watch and like the video decide what YouView shows next.
